  (1) D1 roots: a static root element owned by another static element has its root held by that owning static (A4, RootHeld in WF3), not by frame 0; D1 says 'une racine Modify par emplacement racine, détenue par le cadre 0'. Without this, WF3 fails on the initial state.
  (2) D3 entries keep the fields available and issued of the pass-4 Arena record besides storage and internal; D3 says entries are {storage, internal}.
  (3) D3 ArenaInv revised: 'storage is an owned root' becomes 'storage owned by a place' (OwnedStorage) and 'internal has no origin' is dropped, because D3 lets internal be a block of another arena.
  (4) newArena also requires OwnedStorage (A10: storage owned by the arena value); D3 lists three preconditions only. Claimed counterexample without it: arena on a part of a frame-owned local whose internal is a derived authority held by the frame, then passed as an enterFrame parameter, breaking ArenaInv.
  (5) newArena's internal is the first authority (lowest index) that is active, Modify, held by the owner of storage, with footprint exactly that of storage; newArena rejects if none.
  (6) arena_inv_preserved gains hypothesis (hlive : s'.Active ar.internal), needed at the exit when internal is a derived block.

The module tests that variant (reset rejected while the child lives, accepted after release of the child's internal).
  (8) The case 'retour d'une valeur contenant un accès dérivé Modify' is realised with an arena block, since derive and split give the frame as holder.

      "title": "arenaInternal's lowest-index choice gives a nested child the parent's internal instead of the block, against D3",
      "severity": "major",
      "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:6637-6649 (IsInternalFor, arenaInternal), used by NewArenaPre/newArenaEff 6655-6666; decision (5)",
      "cause": "formalization error",
      "evidence": "D3 says internal is « l'autorité de bloc si storage est un bloc émis par une autre arène (arène imbriquée) ». D3's general wording (« l'autorité Modify détenue par le propriétaire de storage et couvrant exactement son empreinte ») can match more than one authority, and arenaInternal then takes the lowest index without saying so.\n\nLean witness, checked with `lake env lean` (w1_reachable: axioms propext and Quot.sound only), files /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev10/d3/w1.lean and w5.lean:\n- Setup: frame 1 has locals 0 (arena value), 1 (allocator) and 2. `alloc 1 0 [(none,none,0),(some 3,none,0)]` creates root 3 with a single part 4, so `footprint 3 = footprint 4 = [4]`. Then `newArena 3` creates arX = ⟨3,3,[4],[]⟩, and the parent issues [4] to 0, giving block 4 (origin 3, holder .place 0, footprint [4], Modify).\n- Choice: `IsInternalFor x4 4 3 ∧ IsInternalFor x4 4 4 ∧ arenaInternal x4 4 = some 3`, so both authorities qualify. `newArena 4` records ⟨4, 3, [4], []⟩: the child gets the parent's internal 3, which is not derived from it, instead of block 4.\n- Accepted programs change in three ways:\n  - `IssueAt K0 1 0 [4] 2 x5 .reject` (noRight), while the same IssueStep with internal = block 4 is `.ok`.\n  - After `ReleaseStep 4`, the child is still live (`Active 3`), yet `ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (releaseEff x5 4) (.ok _)` succeeds.       "title": "'no live arena already has this storage' compared by place index: two live arenas share the same leaves and internal",
      "severity": "minor",
      "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:6655-6658 (NewArenaPre, clause ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.storage ≠ storage)",
      "cause": "spec defect",
      "evidence": "D3's precondition is « aucune arène vivante n'a déjà ce stockage ». The model compares place indices, but two distinct places can have the same leaves (a root whose only part is a leaf). D3's parenthetical internal cases (« sa racine si storage est une racine allouée, l'autorité de bloc si ... ») cover neither place here.\n\nLean witness, checked (w2_reachable: propext and Quot.sound only), files /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev10/d3/w2.lean and w7.lean:\n- `alloc` creates root 4 with single part 5, so `footprint 4 = footprint 5 = [5]`.\n- `NewArenaStep 4 y2 (.ok y3)` and then `NewArenaStep 5 y3 (.ok y4)`, with `y4.arenas` = [(4,4,[5]),(5,4,[5])].       "suggested_fix": "Ask whether « ce stockage » means the place or its leaves. If it means the leaves, compare footprints (overlap) of live entries instead of storage indices."

      "title": "Claim (7) confirmed: a nested child arena always has the parent's arena value, so D3's nested case and its 'endUse of the child' test cannot be realised",
      "severity": "minor",
      "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:8428-8470 (nested arena section); D3 « Arènes imbriquées »; task case « ok après endUse de l'enfant et de son bloc »",
      "cause": "spec defect",
      "evidence": "D3 assumes the child's storage (a block region) is owned by the holder of the block, the destination value. In the model, issueEff does not change any place's owner. So any child shares a leaf with its parent and, in every reached state (where WF3 holds), has the same arena value. The endUse of the child value is therefore the endUse of the parent value. The module substitutes `release` of the child's internal, which deviates from the task case.\n\nSide note: the example `IssueAt K0 1 0 [3] 1 (releaseEff nA5 3) .reject` also rejects in the live state nA5, because destination 1 is Init (`nA5.I 1 = .init`). It does not test D3's dead-entry rule. The b-case does isolate that rule: after endUse only `Active 4` fails.",
      "suggested_fix": "Get an arbitrage on the ownership of an issued region (or accept the release-based variant). Until then, keep the case reported as unrealisable."
    }
  ]

- Do exactly the task. No unrequested features, generalization, refactoring or "robustness" additions. Put suggestions in the report.
- Do not edit `specs/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `formal/DESIGN.md` unless the task says so.

## Lean

- The Lake project is in `formal/`. `formal/DESIGN.md` governs how to formalize, never what the semantics is. Propose design decisions it does not settle in your report; never take them silently.
- Every definition or theorem that encodes a spec rule cites the rule's location in its docstring.
- A definition says what its rule says. Never make a definition more permissive, add an unjustified hypothesis or narrow a theorem's domain to obtain a proof.
- Never change a theorem statement, or a definition it depends on, to make a proof go through. If stuck, stop and report the goal state.
- Never use `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`.
- Every `.lean` file under `formal/` is part of the build target.

## Report

Spec passages implemented (by location), what changed, what is unproven or open, spec problems found.

## Review (Codex)

Adversarial and read-only. For each change, check:

- It says exactly what the spec says: not stronger, not weaker. Read definitions, hypotheses and quantifiers, not only proofs. A theorem that holds because a definition is too permissive or its hypotheses are unsatisfiable is blocking.
- Each formalized rule cites its spec location.
- No theorem statement or dependency was changed without the task allowing it.
- No interpretation was chosen silently where the spec is unclear.
- Nothing outside the task was added.

When a milestone is declared complete, compare the rules in its announced scope with the spec locations cited in `formal/`, and list every rule left without a definition or theorem.

Every finding needs evidence: a spec quote, a counterexample or command output. No evidence, no finding. Never ask for additions beyond the task.

Output: verdict (block / changes / ok), then each finding with severity, location, cause (formalization error, missing coverage or spec defect) and evidence.
